effects: Takes exactly `assets` AUSD from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets) in enter).
Mints PAPY vault shares to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), set by the vault's stored share price after accrueInterest; there is no minimum.
Sends the deposited AUSD on to the liquidity adapter. This is internal to the vault and does not change what the signer receives.
formats.shown: Deposit 10 AUSD, with PAPY shares sent to the onBehalf address. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of PAPY shares minted is not shown, because the vault's stored price sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` comes from totalAssets/totalSupply in storage, and no calldata parameter bounds it. Case 0: 10 PAPY in, shown only as the ticker 'PAPY'.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The contract takes no minShares parameter.

cases.notes: The 10 AUSD out is shown exactly. The 10 PAPY in is shown by ticker and recipient (the signer) but not by amount. The amount comes from storage, so the descriptor cannot show it.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns PAPY shares from `onBehalf`. The amount is previewWithdraw(assets), rounded up, and comes from the stored share price; there is no maximum.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, it uses up the signer's share allowance from `onBehalf` by the shares burned.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 230115 AUSD to the receiver, with the owner whose shares are used shown as its own field. The number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of PAPY shares burned is not shown, because the stored price sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` then `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)` in exit. Case 1: 230053.537163524540825124 PAPY burned from the signer, and no field shows it.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The contract takes no maxShares parameter.

cases.notes: The 230115 AUSD in to the signer is shown exactly. The PAPY burned is implied by 'Withdraw' and the Owner field, but its amount is not shown. The amount comes from storage.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` PAPY from `onBehalf`. If the signer is not `onBehalf`, it uses up the signer's share allowance by that amount.
Sends AUSD to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), set by the stored share price; there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 39412.118868381429267006 PAPY to the receiver, with the owner shown. Nothing says that AUSD is what comes back.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says the signer receives AUSD. The blind reader did not know which asset arrives.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` sends AUSD. Descriptor intent 'Redeem' and interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} to {#.receiver}' never name AUSD, though the constant underlyingTicker 'AUSD' exists. Case 2: 39422.143797 AUSD came in to the signer; the reader wrote 'Unknown asset and amount'.
findings.fix: Name the asset received, e.g. interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {#.shares} for AUSD to {#.receiver}' and a label 'Receive AUSD at'.

findings.title: redeem: the AUSD amount received is not shown and has no minimum, because the stored price sets it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);` and no calldata parameter bounds it. Case 2: 39422.143797 AUSD in.

cases.notes: The PAPY burned is shown exactly. For the AUSD in, the screen shows only the receiver; the asset is never named and the amount comes from storage.
